Get CBA Play-by-Play

Source: R/cba.R
cba_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a finished game, every period merged, oldest first (Chinese text; no player or team ids).

Endpoint: POST https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/schedule-eventses/filterPage (JSON body)

Usage

cba_pbp(schedule_id, quarter_num = NULL)

Arguments

schedule_id

(required) Required. CBA game id (integer), the global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx (100105799 = 2025-26 round 1). Only a finished game is served.

quarter_num

(optional) Optional period number. Omitted = every period (the API serves one period per request; the runtime fetches them all and checks the set).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per play, oldest first, all periods. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cba_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
schedule_idintegerCBA game id (key space: CBA games, ONE global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx across seasons and match types; the {scheduleId} of every game route). Stamped by the runtime from the request; null on a body parsed without it.
bt_textual_formatcharacterSecond copy of the description; equal to textualFormat on every sampled row (unverified difference).
colorcharacterHex colour of the acting team (homeColor or visitingColor).
distancecharacterUnobserved: null in every sample (a shot distance slot). The API has NO shot x/y coordinates.
home_colorcharacterHome team colour '#RRGGBB'.
home_scoreintegerHome team points after the play. NOT monotone row by row: a substitution row can carry a stale score (2017 game, Q1 0:40); the game's final score is the maximum.
minutesintegerGame clock, minutes REMAINING in the period (counts down: 10 or 12 at the start, depending on the era).
player_cn_namescharacterNames (Chinese surnames/short names) of the players in textualFormat, in order of mention (shooter or fouler first, then assister, rebounder or fouled player). 0-3 names. There are NO player ids in the play-by-play.
player_foulscharacterUnobserved: null in every sample (a player's fouls slot).
player_scorecharacterUnobserved: null in every sample (a player's points slot).
quarter_numintegerPeriod of the row (1-4; 5+ would be overtime). Equals the request's quarterNum on every row.
secondsintegerGame clock, seconds remaining within the minute.
team_cn_alias1characterUnobserved: null in every sample (a team-name slot).
team_cn_alias2characterUnobserved: null in every sample (a team-name slot).
team_cn_alias3characterUnobserved: null in every sample (a team-name slot).
textual_formatcharacterPlay description sentence (Chinese) naming the players; the phrase glossary translates every form seen. Team names inside it can be a different era's name than the game header (a 2025-26 text reads (Chinese text)). Sentence forms ({P} a player, {T} a team): {T}``{T} substitution, {P} replaces {P}; {P} three-point jump shot, misses, {P} gets the defensive rebound; {P} layup (driving), scores; {P} takes two free throws, free throw 2 made; (Chinese text) (Chinese text) = {P} shooting foul on the opponent's shot (drawn by an unnamed player); {P} receives an assist from {P}, jump shot, three-pointer made; the full glossary is in cba_glossary.yaml.
typeintegerTeam the play belongs to: 1 = home, 2 = visiting (checked on all 667 rows of two games: color equals homeColor when 1 and visitingColor when 2). See the code table.
visiting_colorcharacterVisiting team colour '#RRGGBB'.
visitor_scoreintegerVisiting team points after the play (same caveat as homeScore).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cba_seasons().

See also

Other CBA Functions: cba_best_player(), cba_best_stats(), cba_game_info(), cba_game_team_four(), cba_game_team_shots(), cba_match_types(), cba_period_scores(), cba_player_advanced(), cba_player_base(), cba_player_box(), cba_player_defensive(), cba_player_extras(), cba_player_offensive(), cba_player_shots(), cba_report_status(), cba_rosters(), cba_schedule_day(), cba_schedule_month(), cba_seasons(), cba_team_basic(), cba_team_counts(), cba_team_four(), cba_team_options(), cba_team_overview(), cba_team_shots(), cba_teams()
